entries.title: Psalms 70:1
segments: ¶<To the chief music-maker. Of David. To keep in memory.> Let your salvation come quickly, O God; come quickly to my help, O Lord.

entries.title: Psalms 70:2
segments: Let those who go after my soul have shame and trouble; let those who have evil designs against me be turned back and made foolish.

entries.title: Psalms 70:3
segments: Let those who say Aha, aha! be turned back as a reward of their shame.

entries.title: Psalms 70:4
segments: Let all those who are looking for you be glad and have joy in you; let the lovers of your salvation ever say, May God be great.

entries.title: Psalms 70:5
segments: But I am poor and in need; come to me quickly, O God; you are my help and my saviour; let there be no waiting, O Lord.
